 Print Kareena Kapoor Khan REVEALS she was 'screaming on the road RUKO RUKO' as she and Saif Ali Khan open up about the stabbing incident on 'Koffee With Karan 9' Kareena Kapoor Khan and Saif Ali Khan appear together on Episode 4 of ‘ Koffee With Karan Season 9’ tonight. The couple talks about the stabbing incident from January 2025, and the promos have already raised excitement among viewers. Saif Ali Khan and Kareena Kapoor Khan talk about the stabbing incident
 Kareena Kapoor Khan shared that she could not sleep for six months after the attack because she was so scared. She recalled, “I was screaming on the road, ‘Ruko, ruko.' It was like a movie scene.” Saif called it “the worst night in the history of nights”. He also spoke about how long it took him to recover, given how serious his injuries were. The tension doubled as their children witnessed it. The couple also spoke about the support they received from family and friends during that period. What happened that night
 In the early hours of January 16, 2025, Saif was stabbed six times by an unidentified person at his Mumbai home. He suffered injuries to his spine, neck and hands. He underwent a 2.5-hour neurosurgery, along with plastic surgery, at Lilavati Hospital. Highlights from the teaser
 The teaser shows Kareena teasing host Karan Johar as usual. She says she is “happy and relieved” because the show is reaching its final season. She adds, “We don’t have to keep coming on ‘Koffee With Karan’.” Karan replies, “Thank you for showing your sensitivity towards the last season of the show.” Saif then interrupts the best friends and says he feels he is a “miscast” on the show. When Karan asks Kareena who the No. 1 actor is among the current lot, the answer is easy to guess. Saif jumps in and says, “You are allowed to praise other actors as well.” In the gaming round, the couple is asked to name actors whose names start with K. Saif comes up with a random “Kavita” and later says, “There’ll be someone like Kavita, right?” Who appeared earlier this season
 Salman Khan, Rashmika Mandanna and Vijay Deverakonda, and Janhvi Kapoor and Varun Dhawan have already appeared on the show this season.
